With a Master's in Computer Applications (MCA) from United School of Business Management, I build high-performance distributed platforms, real-time communication systems, and production-ready generative AI pipelines.
about.description2: My work bridges scalable backend systems, responsive frontend interfaces, and cutting-edge AI architectures—including automated HeyGen/FFmpeg video generation pipelines, zero-dependency embeddable agentic copilots, live spatial marketplaces, and enterprise RAG engines.

Projects.project_name: Orbito — AI Project & Task Management Platform
Projects.description: Production-grade enterprise task and project management platform with conversational AI task execution, in-app DOM browser automation, sub-millisecond WebSocket event broadcasting, and multi-view project canvas.
Projects.long_description: Architected and engineered Orbito, an enterprise project management platform designed with Clean Architecture and Domain-Driven Design (DDD). Combines a minimalist keyboard-first Linear-style UI with real-time WebSocket communication and a conversational AI command runner. Features in-app DOM browser automation (browser-agent) capable of executing multi-step workflows, multi-view canvases (Kanban with LexoRank drag-and-drop, interactive list views, sprint planning, burndown charts, and Gantt timelines), BullMQ distributed background job queues, and AES-256-GCM encrypted credential storage.
Projects.metrics: Clean Architecture & DDD • In-App Browser Automation • Sub-ms WebSocket Broadcast
architecture: Clean Architecture & DDD: Domain entities, application use cases, and infrastructure adapters strictly decoupled
Conversational AI Execution Engine: In-app DOM browser automation translating natural-language intent into multi-step actions
Real-Time Event Broadcasting: Sub-millisecond WebSocket channels across organizations, workspaces, and project rooms
Resilient Job Queues: BullMQ distributed background pipelines with automatic retries and AES-256-GCM encryption
highlights: Engineered conversational AI task execution directly within the browser interface
Implemented LexoRank drag-and-drop Kanban boards with instant optimistic state synchronization
Built multi-tenant enterprise RBAC with JWT token rotation and secure OIDC integration

Projects.description: Institutional AI-powered learning and automated media synthesis platform featuring an automated HeyGen and FFmpeg video generation pipeline, AWS Bedrock curriculum intelligence, dynamic chapter sequencing, and real-time WebRTC interactive guidance.
Projects.long_description: Architected and engineered an institutional AI learning and automated media synthesis platform. Spearheaded a hybrid AI media processing pipeline using AWS Bedrock (Anthropic Claude), the HeyGen API, and queue-driven FFmpeg worker nodes to generate photorealistic AI video lectures from structured curriculum scripts, cutting batch production turnaround by 60% across 100+ production batches. Integrated real-time WebRTC interactive communication rooms with a pgvector RAG curriculum index, enabling learners to participate in real-time interactive voice/video sessions with synchronized contextual transcripts, automated quiz generation, and verifiable knowledge assessments.
Projects.metrics: 60% Batch Turnaround Cut • 100+ Production Batches • Real-Time WebRTC Media
architecture: Distributed Media Worker Pipeline: Queue-driven FFmpeg and HeyGen API synthesis with chunked rendering
Curriculum Intelligence Engine: AWS Bedrock Claude foundation models automating outline synthesis and assessment scripts
Low-Latency WebRTC Mesh: Peer-to-peer interactive tutoring rooms with echo-cancelled audio and live canvas sync
pgvector Semantic Index: PostgreSQL vector embeddings for instant chapter lookup and contextual retrieval
highlights: Drove a 60% batch turnaround reduction across 100+ production batches with distributed FFmpeg and HeyGen pipelines
Spearheaded hybrid AI media processing combining AWS Bedrock foundation intelligence with dynamic video synthesis
Engineered real-time interactive learning rooms with low-latency WebRTC audio/video and synchronized transcripts
Architected scalable microservices with Python FastAPI, Next.js 15, PostgreSQL, and Redis caching

Projects.project_name: ReviewSage AI — Autonomous Deep Research Agent
Projects.description: Enterprise-grade, state-driven multi-agent research platform built with LangGraph.js, Next.js, and Google Gemini. Features autonomous search planning, SSRF-safe hybrid web/RAG search, evidence verification, and durable PostgreSQL checkpoint telemetry.
Projects.long_description: Engineered ReviewSage AI, an enterprise multi-agent research platform that investigates complex inquiries, gathers live web evidence with SSRF protections, indexes private knowledge bases, and synthesizes cited research reports. Operates as a coordinated state machine built on LangGraph.js, Google Gemini, and Ollama: coordinating Planner, Hybrid Searcher, Reviewer, and Reporter nodes with durable session checkpointing in PostgreSQL and telemetry logging.
Projects.metrics: Multi-Agent State Machine • Evidence Review Loop • Durable PostgreSQL Checkpoints
architecture: LangGraph State Machine: Coordinated Planner, Hybrid Searcher, Reviewer, and Reporter cyclical execution loop
Evidence Review Engine: State-driven reviewer node validating claims and excerpt containment against evidence
Durable Session Checkpointing: Full state rollback and execution logs persisted directly to PostgreSQL
SSRF-Protected Search: Hybrid live web search combined with private document indexing and relevance scoring
highlights: Eliminated fabricated links and phantom claims with deterministic citation verification
Built interactive Next.js web command center with live Server-Sent Events (SSE) execution streaming
Executed 33 comprehensive unit tests across 11 test suites with sub-second execution times

Engineered modular React hooks and optimized media with Next.js Image, propelling Lighthouse performance and SEO scores to 95+.

Projects.description: A modern component library for building beautiful, accessible interfaces with TypeScript and Tailwind CSS. Features 75+ standalone components, AI primitives, zero external UI runtime dependencies, full keyboard accessibility, and interactive theme builder.
Projects.long_description: Created Oryn UI (oryn-ui), an open-source React component library and design system published on npm. Features 75+ standalone components and AI primitives built with zero external UI runtime dependencies. Adheres to strict Layer Architecture, full keyboard accessibility, and zero-runtime style recalculation. Includes an interactive live theme builder, CLI component distributor, and comprehensive Vitest test coverage.
Projects.metrics: Published on npm (oryn-ui) • 75+ Primitives • Zero External UI Runtime Dependencies • React 19
architecture: Zero External UI Runtime Dependencies: 100% native React primitives (Slot, Portal, Presence, FocusTrap) and inline SVG icons
Architecture-by-Layer: Strict separation across core tokens, primitive behaviors, and styled compound components
Theme Engine: CSS custom property design tokens enabling seamless dark mode and instant theme switching
Compound Component Pattern: Ergonomic, declarative APIs with flexible child composition and focus trapping
highlights: Published publicly on npm as oryn-ui with live interactive documentation at oryn-ui.vercel.app
Includes 75+ standalone components and specialized AI interface primitives
Full keyboard navigation and accessible component states with automated Vitest suites
